## Composite read primitives

Not one-to-one with CATS endpoints. Each answers a question that would
otherwise cost several round trips, and returns a compact table rather than
full records. Data access only - they report facts, never decisions.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `get_candidate_summaries` | compact profiles for a batch of candidate ids |
| `get_candidate_engagement` | last contact date and activity counts for a batch |
| `get_job_candidate_pool` | a job's pipeline joined to candidate profiles |
| `get_changed_records` | what changed since an event id or timestamp |
| `get_pipeline_summaries` | status for a batch of pipeline ids |

## Resources

Read-only context, lazy-loaded. Resources are data a client reads; tools
are actions a model invokes. The first three work with CATS unreachable.

| URI | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cats://server/capabilities` | what this adapter owns, does not own, and how it is configured |
| `cats://server/tools` | catalog shape by toolset and safety class |
| `cats://account/rate-limit` | live request budget |
| `cats://account/site` | which CATS account is connected |
| `cats://reference/workflows` | account-specific pipeline stages and their status ids |
| `cats://reference/custom-fields/{resource}` | custom field definitions and ids |

## Prompts

Guidance on operating the CATS API correctly - resolving account-specific
ids, staying inside the request budget. Deliberately nothing about who to
contact or how to rank anyone; `tests/test_prompts.py` enforces that.

| Prompt | Prevents |
| --- | --- |
| `change_pipeline_stage_safely` | a valid-but-wrong status id silently moving a record |
| `search_within_rate_budget` | a lookup loop exhausting the hourly limit |
| `find_the_right_custom_field` | guessing account-specific custom field ids |
| `record_an_external_interaction` | assuming this server sends email or SMS - it does not |
